laws: While readiness blockers exist, package.json must remain 0.0.0 and no v1.0.0 tag/release SHA may be declared.
When blockers are empty, BERS_V1_RC must be one exact accepted main SHA and affected final release evidence must be terminal green on that coordinate.
Final release state requires package.json version 1.0.0, releaseTag v1.0.0 and releaseSha equal to the exact accepted release coordinate.
A release-affecting fix after RC moves the coordinate to the new accepted main SHA and requires rerunning affected evidence before finalization.
